newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile judge to probe alleged child abuse.
newsitem.headline: Chile judge to probe alleged child abuse.

text.p: Chile's Supreme Court on Friday appointed a judge to investigate claims of child sex abuse by members of a secretive German community in southern Chile.

The authorities issued an arrest warrant last year against Paul Schaeffer, a German immigrant who founded the Colonia dignidad (Dignity Colony) settlement, on charges of molesting young boys. Police searches for him have proved fruitless.
The case surfaced again this week when families of several more boys accused colony members of abusing and illegally imprisoning their children.
Lawyers for the colony's several hundred inhabitants have dismissed the claims as groundless.
"There are no kidnappings. The children were here with the authorisation of their parents," lawyer Waldo Ortega said.
The colony was founded in the early 1960s at the foot of the Andes near the town of Parral, and runs a boarding school for children from neighbouring districts.
